units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 22a:6">B. Bath. 22ᵃ</cite> <he>פוק תהי ליה בקַנְקַנֵּיה</he> go and smell at his vessel, i.e. examine his mental capacity; a. e.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 2:4:12">Y. Ber. II, 5ᵃ</cite> top <he>שרי … קַנְקַנָּיךְ וכ׳</he> untie thy ox and untie thy plough, for the Temple has been destroyed; <he>קטור … קנקניך וכ׳</he> tie thy ox and tie thy plough, for king Messiah was born; <cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:57">Lam. R. to I, 16</cite> Ar. (ed. <he>פדנך</he>).
